name: Lu4 Wiki: NPC Captain of Red Flag Shaka

links.name: Raid Boss Lv. 1 If the person who made the greatest contribution is 3 or more Lv.s higher than the raid monster, then the item/Adena rewards will decrease. If the difference is 9 or more Lv.s, the monster will drop nothing at all.

Raid Boss Lv. 1 The leader of the Red Flag of the Oel Mahum, who waits for his opportunity to take over the Bandit Stronghold. He is tremendously proud of being an Oel Mahum. Although smart, hearty and brave, he is still young and is still growing into his power. He boasts that one day he will build a kingdom of Oel Mahums.
Humanoids Lv. 6 Takes 15% increased damage from attacks that are effective against Humanoids. Atk. Spd. +2.5% Accuracy +3 Evasion +2 P. Def. -5% Received Critical Damage +5% Resistance to Bleed -10%
